citationText: The early sound period also saw experimentation with stereo sound by Harvey Fletcher at Bell Labs, who transmitted a concert performance in stereo in 1933, and by Alan Blumlein of EMI, who developed a stereo photographic track in the same year. Elements of this technology, especially Fletcher's work, would Figure crucially in the development of Warner's Vitasound ( 1940 ) and Disney's Fantasound ( 1942 ).
